description: Hizb al-Bahr of Imam Abu al-Hasan al-Shadhili, in the order of the recitation. The Qur'anic passages the litany recites in full are collection items, not adhkar; the fragments here — where the wird recites only part of a verse — are sliced verbatim out of sources/quran/ayahs.json, so no Qur'anic text is transcribed by hand.

adhkar.text_arabic: يَا اللهُ يَاعَلِيُّ يَاعَظِيمُ يَاحَلِيمُ يَاعَلِيمُ، أَنْتَ رَبِّي وَعِلْمُكَ حَسْبِي، فَنِعْمَ الرَّبُّ رَبِّي وَنِعْمَ الْحَسْبُ حَسْبِي، تَنْصُرُ مَنْ تَشَاءُ وَأَنْتَ الْعَزِيزُ الرَّحِيمُ
adhkar.translation: O Allah, O High, O Great, O Clement, O All-Knowing; You are my Lord and Your knowledge is my sufficiency; how perfect, then, is my Lord, how perfect my sufficiency! You give victory to whom You will, and You are the Almighty, the Merciful.
adhkar.transliteration: Yā Allāhu Yā ʿAliyyu Yā ʿAẓīmu Yā Ḥalīmu Yā ʿAlīm, anta Rabbī wa-ʿilmuka ḥasbī, fa-niʿma r-Rabbu Rabbī wa-niʿma l-ḥasbu ḥasbī, tanṣuru man tashāʾu wa-anta l-ʿAzīzu r-Raḥīm.

adhkar.text_arabic: نَسْأَلُكَ الْعِصْمَةَ فِي الْحَرَكَاتِ وَالسَّكَنَاتِ وَالْكَلِمَاتِ وَالْإِرَادَاتِ وَالْخَطَرَاتِ مِنَ الشُّكُوكِ وَالظُّنُونِ وَالْأَوْهَامِ السَّاتِرَةِ لِلْقُلُوبِ عَنْ مُطَالَعَةِ الْغُيُوبِ
adhkar.translation: We ask Your protection in movements and rests, in words and desires and thoughts; from the doubts, suppositions, and fancies that veil hearts from beholding things unseen.
adhkar.transliteration: Nasʾaluka l-ʿiṣmata fi l-ḥarakāti wa-s-sakanāti wa-l-kalimāti wa-l-irādāti wa-l-khaṭarāti mina sh-shukūki wa-ẓ-ẓunūni wa-l-awhāmi s-sātirati li-l-qulūbi ʿan muṭālaʿati l-ghuyūb.

adhkar.text_arabic: فَقَدِ ٱبۡتُلِيَ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنُونَ وَزُلۡزِلُواْ زِلۡزَالٗا شَدِيدٗا وَإِذۡ يَقُولُ ٱلۡمُنَٰفِقُونَ وَٱلَّذِينَ فِي قُلُوبِهِم مَّرَضٞ مَّا وَعَدَنَا ٱللَّهُ وَرَسُولُهُۥٓ إِلَّا غُرُورٗا
adhkar.translation: For the believers have been tried, and mightily shaken; and lo, the hypocrites and those with sickness in their hearts say: Allah and His Messenger have promised us nothing but delusion.
adhkar.transliteration: Fa-qadi-btuliya l-muʾminūna wa-zulzilū zilzālan shadīdan, wa-idh yaqūlu l-munāfiqūna wa-lladhīna fī qulūbihim maraḍun mā waʿadana Llāhu wa-Rasūluhu illā ghurūrā.
adhkar.notes: Qur’an 33:11-12. The wird opens the passage on فَقَدِ in place of the verse’s own هُنَالِكَ; the rest is the two verses in full.

adhkar.text_arabic: فَثَبِّتْنَا وَانْصُرْنَا وَسَخِّرْ لَنَا هَذَا الْبَحْرَ كَمَا سَخَّرْتَ الْبَحْرَ لِمُوسَى، وَسَخَّرْتَ النَّارَ لِإِبْرَاهِيمَ، وَسَخَّرْتَ الْجِبَالَ وَالْحَدِيدَ لِدَاوُدَ، وَسَخَّرْتَ الرِّيحَ وَالشَّيَاطِينَ وَالْجِنَّ لِسُلَيْمَانَ
adhkar.translation: So make us steadfast, give us victory, and subject to us this sea, as You subjected the sea to Moses, the fire to Abraham, the mountains and iron to David, and the wind and the demons and the jinn to Solomon.
adhkar.transliteration: Fa-thabbitnā wa-nṣurnā wa-sakhkhir lanā hādha l-baḥra kamā sakhkharta l-baḥra li-Mūsā, wa-sakhkharta n-nāra li-Ibrāhīma, wa-sakhkharta l-jibāla wa-l-ḥadīda li-Dāwūda, wa-sakhkharta r-rīḥa wa-sh-shayāṭīna wa-l-jinna li-Sulaymān.

adhkar.text_arabic: وَسَخِّرْ لَنَا كُلَّ بَحْرٍ هُوَ لَكَ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَالسَّمَاءِ وَالْمُلْكِ وَالْمَلَكُوتِ، وَبَحْرَ الدُّنْيَا وَبَحْرَ الْآخِرَةِ، وَسَخِّرْ لَنَا كُلَّ شَيْءٍ، يَا مَنْ بِيَدِهِ مَلَكُوتُ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ
adhkar.translation: Subject to us every sea You possess, in the earth and the sky, the kingdom and the dominion, the sea of this life and the sea of the life to come. Subject to us everything, O You in whose hand is the dominion of everything.
adhkar.transliteration: Wa-sakhkhir lanā kulla baḥrin huwa laka fi l-arḍi wa-s-samāʾi wa-l-mulki wa-l-malakūti, wa-baḥra d-dunyā wa-baḥra l-ākhirati, wa-sakhkhir lanā kulla shayʾin, yā man bi-yadihi malakūtu kulli shayʾ.

adhkar.text_arabic: أُنْصُرْنَا فَإِنَّكَ خَيْرُ النَّاصِرِينَ، وَافْتَحْ لَنَا فَإِنَّكَ خَيْرُ الْفَاتِحِينَ، وَاغْفِرْ لَنَا فَإِنَّكَ خَيْرُ الْغَافِرِينَ، وَارْحَمْنَا فَإِنَّكَ خَيْرُ الرَّاحِمِينَ، وَارْزُقْنَا فَإِنَّكَ خَيْرُ الرَّازِقِينَ، وَاهْدِنَا وَنَجِّنَا مِنَ الْقَوْمِ الظَّالِمِينَ
adhkar.translation: Give us victory, for You are the best who give victory. Open the way for us, for You are the best who open. Forgive us, for You are the best of forgivers. Have mercy on us, for You are the best of the merciful. Give us sustenance, for You are the best of providers. Guide us, and save us from the wrongdoing folk.
adhkar.transliteration: Unṣurnā fa-innaka khayru n-nāṣirīna, wa-ftaḥ lanā fa-innaka khayru l-fātiḥīna, wa-ghfir lanā fa-innaka khayru l-ghāfirīna, wa-rḥamnā fa-innaka khayru r-rāḥimīna, wa-rzuqnā fa-innaka khayru r-rāziqīna, wa-hdinā wa-najjinā mina l-qawmi ẓ-ẓālimīn.

adhkar.text_arabic: وَهَبْ لَنَا رِيحًا طَيِّبَةً كَمَا هِيَ فِي عِلْمِكَ، وَانْشُرْهَا عَلَيْنَا مِنْ خَزَائِنِ رَحْمَتِكَ، وَاحْمِلْنَا بِهَا حَمْلَ الْكَرَامَةِ مَعَ السَّلَامَةِ وَالْعَافِيَةِ فِي الدِّينِ وَالدُّنْيَا وَالْآخِرَةِ، إِنَّكَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
adhkar.translation: Give us a goodly wind, as it is in Your knowledge; loose it upon us from the storehouses of Your mercy; and carry us upon it in honour, with safety and wellbeing in our religion, in this world and in the world to come. Truly, You have power over all things.
adhkar.transliteration: Wa-hab lanā rīḥan ṭayyibatan kamā hiya fī ʿilmika, wa-nshurhā ʿalaynā min khazāʾini raḥmatika, wa-ḥmilnā bihā ḥamla l-karāmati maʿa s-salāmati wa-l-ʿāfiyati fi d-dīni wa-d-dunyā wa-l-ākhirati, innaka ʿalā kulli shayʾin Qadīr.

adhkar.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ يَسِّرْ لَنَا أُمُورَنَا مَعَ الرَّاحَةِ لِقُلُوبِنَا وَأَبْدَانِنَا وَالسَّلَامَةِ وَالْعَافِيَةِ فِي دِينِنَا وَدُنْيَانَا، وَكُنْ لَنَا صَاحِبًا فِي سَفَرِنَا وَخَلِيفَةً فِي أَهْلِنَا، وَاطْمِسْ عَلَى وُجُوهِ أَعْدَائِنَا وَامْسَخْهُمْ عَلَى مَكَانَتِهِمْ فَلَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ الْمُضِيَّ وَلَا الْمَجِيءَ إِلَيْنَا
adhkar.translation: O Allah, give us ease in our affairs, with rest for our hearts and our bodies, and safety and wellbeing in our religion and our worldly life. Be our companion in our travels, and keep watch over our families in our stead. Blot out the faces of our enemies, and fix them where they stand, so they can neither move nor reach us.
adhkar.transliteration: Allāhumma yassir lanā umūranā maʿa r-rāḥati li-qulūbinā wa-abdāninā wa-s-salāmati wa-l-ʿāfiyati fī dīninā wa-dunyānā, wa-kun lanā ṣāḥiban fī safarinā wa-khalīfatan fī ahlinā, wa-ṭmis ʿalā wujūhi aʿdāʾinā wa-msakhhum ʿalā makānatihim falā yastaṭīʿūna l-muḍiyya wa-lā l-majīʾa ilaynā.

adhkar.text_arabic: شَاهَتِ الْوُجُوهُ
adhkar.translation: Disfigured be those faces!
adhkar.transliteration: Shāhati l-wujūh.

adhkar.text_arabic: طسٓ، حمٓ، عٓسٓقٓ
adhkar.translation: Ṭā Sīn, Hā Mīm, ʿAyn Sīn Qāf.
adhkar.transliteration: Ṭā Sīn, Hā Mīm, ʿAyn Sīn Qāf.
adhkar.notes: The three sets of disjoined letters recited together at this point, from the openings of Sūrat al-Naml, Sūrat Ghāfir and Sūrat al-Shūrā.

adhkar.text_arabic: حمٓ
adhkar.translation: Hā Mīm.
adhkar.transliteration: Hā Mīm.

adhkar.text_arabic: حُمَّ الْأَمْرُ وَجَاءَ النَّصْرُ فَعَلَيْنَا لَا يُنْصَرُونَ
adhkar.translation: The matter is done, the victory come. Against us they shall not be helped.
adhkar.transliteration: Ḥumma l-amru wa-jāʾa n-naṣru fa-ʿalaynā lā yunṣarūn.

adhkar.text_arabic: بِسْمِ اللهِ بَابُنَا
adhkar.translation: “In the name of Allah” is our door.
adhkar.transliteration: Bismi Llāhi bābunā.

adhkar.text_arabic: تَبَارَكَ حِيطَانُنَا
adhkar.translation: “Tabāraka” is our walls.
adhkar.transliteration: Tabāraka ḥīṭānunā.

adhkar.text_arabic: يسٓ سَقْفُنَا
adhkar.translation: “Yā Sīn” is our roof.
adhkar.transliteration: Yā Sīn saqfunā.

adhkar.text_arabic: كٓهيعٓصٓ كِفَايَتُنَا
adhkar.translation: “Kāf Hā Yā ʿAyn Ṣād” is our sufficiency.
adhkar.transliteration: Kāf Hā Yā ʿAyn Ṣād kifāyatunā.

adhkar.text_arabic: حمٓ عٓسٓقٓ حِمَايَتُنَا
adhkar.translation: “Hā Mīm ʿAyn Sīn Qāf” is our protection.
adhkar.transliteration: Hā Mīm ʿAyn Sīn Qāf ḥimāyatunā.

adhkar.text_arabic: فَسَيَكۡفِيكَهُمُ ٱللَّهُۚ وَهُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلۡعَلِيمُ
adhkar.translation: Allah will suffice you against them, and He is the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing.
adhkar.transliteration: Fa-sayakfīkahumu Llāhu wa-Huwa s-Samīʿu l-ʿAlīm.
adhkar.notes: The closing portion of Qur’an 2:137, recited on its own.

adhkar.text_arabic: سِتْرُ الْعَرْشِ مَسْبُولٌ عَلَيْنَا، وَعَيْنُ اللهِ نَاظِرَةٌ إِلَيْنَا، بِحَوْلِ اللهِ لَا يُقْدَرُ عَلَيْنَا
adhkar.translation: The veil of the Throne has been dropped over us; the eye of Allah is gazing upon us; by the power of Allah none shall overcome us.
adhkar.transliteration: Sitru l-ʿArshi masbūlun ʿalaynā, wa-ʿaynu Llāhi nāẓiratun ilaynā, bi-ḥawli Llāhi lā yuqdaru ʿalaynā.

adhkar.text_arabic: فَٱللَّهُ خَيۡرٌ حَٰفِظٗاۖ وَهُوَ أَرۡحَمُ ٱلرَّٰحِمِينَ
adhkar.translation: For Allah is best as protector, and He is the Most Merciful of the merciful.
adhkar.transliteration: Fa-Llāhu khayrun ḥāfiẓan wa-Huwa Arḥamu r-rāḥimīn.
adhkar.notes: The closing portion of Qur’an 12:64, recited on its own.
